high_alert_reason: ISMP high-alert: vasopressor infusion. Narrow therapeutic window; non-titratable in most adult septic-shock protocols.
adult_dose: Fixed dose 0.03 units/min (or 0.04 units/min per Surviving Sepsis Campaign) as adjunct to norepinephrine. Not titrated for hemodynamics.
pediatric_dose: 0.0003–0.002 units/kg/min per PICU protocol (much narrower range than adult).
max_dose: Do not exceed 0.04 units/min in septic shock unless directed by attending; higher doses risk mesenteric / digital ischemia.
indications: Adjunct vasopressor in septic shock on norepinephrine ≥ 0.25 mcg/kg/min
contraindications: Relative: severe peripheral or coronary vascular disease
key_monitoring: Serum sodium (can cause hyponatremia with prolonged use)
